definitions.facility_denominator: Online qualification verification system adopting facilities; not all medical facilities. Facility counts are measured on the last Sunday of each month.
definitions.electronic_count: Monthly pharmacy dispensation-result registrations marked electronic.
definitions.paper_count: Monthly medical-institution paper prescription-information registrations with exchange numbers.
definitions.prohibited_inference: Do not describe electronic/(electronic+paper) as the share of all prescriptions issued electronically. Stages and registering populations differ. No demand-spending or time-savings conclusion from adoption alone.
definitions.latest_dispensation_rate: Recent prescription denominator may be estimated; not a measured count of all prescriptions.

limitations: Read-only underlying-value audit; workbook UI render not performed.
Zip publication date and original HTTP acquisition receipt inherited from the earlier source record, not independently verified here.
No re-fetch of original ZIP, no user notification or publication.
